materials: highly visible coarse paper fibers and paper tooth
scumbled thin paint revealing raw paper

characterRules: keep age, hairstyle, clothing, and temperament continuous across recurring appearances
use specific natural actions instead of posed reading or generic smiling
render people as readable painterly forms rather than photorealistic skin
compositionRules: vertical 9:16 rough-paper sheet is the full canvas
reserve 20 to 30 percent genuinely unpainted raw paper only at the top, bottom, or both; never at the left or right edges
the painted narrative scene occupies at least 70 percent of the sheet, preferably 70 to 80 percent, and reaches both left and right canvas edges
end the painted scene with dry-brush fade, broken edge, scumbled edge, or open contour only along its upper and lower edges
vary top and bottom blank-paper proportion, internal staging, shot scale, and camera view without narrowing the scene horizontally
place bilingual subtitles on a consistent unpainted bottom-paper band, clear of scene objects and strong pigment
do not count walls, sky, fog, floors, or pale in-scene backgrounds as blank paper
avoid: full-height scene with an empty wall used as negative space
unpainted raw paper at left or right edges, or a scene that does not reach both side edges
photograph with yellow or oil-paint filter
photorealistic faces and digital camera sharpness
uniform noise overlay instead of real paper tooth and brush interaction
heavy brown sepia, dirty damaged paper, glossy 3D, purple-blue gradients, and AI glow
generated book titles, captions, logos, or watermarks
